answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the vine of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the voyage of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the river re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing.
